moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio trail-exit, written here): Exit to the right: main element x 0 → +175 px (recipe / readout; the demo moves 210 px on a 320 px canvas, ≈×6 at 1920) and opacity 1 → 0 in 520 ms power3.in (easeInQuart). Three copies under it run the same tween 32, 64 and 96 ms later at 0.42 / 0.24 / 0.12 of its opacity and vanish with it. Entrance before it: fade in 250 ms power2.out. Params: duration (0.52 s) · x: quãng lao (175 px) · copies (3) · delay: trễ mỗi bản (32 ms) · ease (power3.in).
